: [A store salesman, Hairy, is showing Cueball a dehumidifier on a counter with a "SALE" label on it. Several other unidentified devices, possibly other dehumidifier models, are shown on and underneath a shelf in the store as well.]

: Hairy: This dehumidifier model features built-in WiFi for remote updates.
: Cueball: Great! That will be really useful if they discover a new kind of water.
